title: Beyond Parallel/CSIS — Suspected Uranium Enrichment Building at Yongbyon Complete
snippet: Construction began mid-December 2024, largely complete by early June 2025. Located 480m north-northeast of Radiochemistry Laboratory. Similar in scale to Kangson enrichment facility.
tag_reason: 영변 신규 농축시설 관련 5/12 보고서에서 이미 보도됨.
